name: @noxlabs/confidential-transfers-sdk
description: SDK for EVM ERC20 Confidential Transfers
author: Nox Labs

scripts.build: npm run update && tsc -d && mkdir -p dist/artifacts && cp -r artifacts/proofs-helpers dist/artifacts/
scripts.update: npm run update:abi:json && npm run update:abi:ts && npm run update:typechain
scripts.update:abi:json: rm -rf artifacts/abi && mkdir -p artifacts/abi && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const artifact=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("../../out/foundry/ConfidentialTransfers.sol/ConfidentialTransfers.json", "utf8")); fs.writeFileSync("artifacts/abi/ConfidentialTransfers.json", JSON.stringify(artifact.abi, null, 2));'
scripts.update:abi:ts:
node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const abi=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("artifacts/abi/ConfidentialTransfers.json", "utf8")); const content=`export const confidentialTransfersAbi = ${JSON.stringify(abi, null, 2)} as const

export type ConfidentialTransfersAbi = typeof confidentialTransfersAbi
`; fs.writeFileSync("artifacts/abi/ConfidentialTransfers.ts", content);'
scripts.update:typechain: rm -rf artifacts/typechain && mkdir -p artifacts/typechain && mkdir -p artifacts/typechain/src && cp ../../out/hardhat/typechain/src/ConfidentialTransfers.ts artifacts/typechain/src/ && cp ../../out/hardhat/typechain/common.ts artifacts/typechain/ && mkdir -p artifacts/typechain/test/utils/mock && cp ../../out/hardhat/typechain/test/utils/mock/MockERC20.ts artifacts/typechain/test/utils/mock/
